authorization.scope: Write P1346 and execute through implementation only if every preseal gate passes.

transport: Closed manual preflight gives authority corpus, digest and root validation precedence over argparse completeness.
Caller, authorship receipt and delivery receipt form an acyclic externally pinned DAG.
Rehashed probe bytes execute only from a sealed memfd descriptor through /proc/self/fd/N with no path fallback.
source: Exactly 38 canonical capsules across 12 frozen productive consumers.
Exactly 2506 canonical Rust lexical tokens and inverse normalization to all 12 candidate-free files.
Owner-local Func, Content and CounterUpdate helper placement with no non-local impl.

classification.semantic_negative: Violated with public witness and reason_code

allowed: The single explicitly authored opaque execution probe when the authenticated probe runs and returns its closed canonical opacity projection.
must_be_violated: Authority identity mismatch, alternate root/corpus/digest, duplicate or abbreviated flag, unknown argument, alias path, receipt/caller pin mismatch, failed receipt, absent memfd or sealing, replay, schema/type/canonical JSON failure, emitter mismatch, binary mismatch, symlink and swap/restore.
unknown_policy.fail_closed: Ambiguous identity, unsupported parser input and exhausted budget cannot become success; no memfd fallback exists.

baseline_manifest.reads: Only the exact authorized P1346 step, its pinned P1345 inputs, the 12 named L0/consumer pairs and the segregated-materialization skill references.
baseline_manifest.forbidden: Contract, oracle, corpus, attacks, tests, candidate, seal and final verdict.

transport_contract.reads: This manifest, frozen baseline, P1345 FINAL contract and the P1346 step; no candidate.
transport_contract.forbidden: Oracle implementation, corpus execution, productive code, seal and verification.

oracle.reads: Frozen prompt/baseline, this manifest and contract candidate; no productive candidate.
oracle.writes: P1346 probe/checker/caller/corpus/authorship and delivery artifacts only.
oracle.forbidden: Full corpus, productive candidate and seal.

adversary.reads: Frozen intent, contract, oracle artifacts and baseline; no authority to fix them.
adversary.writes: P1346 adversarial runners, reports and receipts only.
adversary.forbidden: Contract/oracle repair, full corpus, productive candidate and seal.

pre_verifier.reads: Frozen inputs plus delivery-receipt SHA supplied out of band.
pre_verifier.writes: One P1346 full preseal report, receipt and seal only.
pre_verifier.forbidden: Correction of any verified input or candidate implementation.

ab_tester.reads: Frozen L0, contract and seal; no candidate patch before its test is frozen.
ab_tester.writes: P1346 independent test and RED receipt only.
ab_tester.forbidden: Productive implementation, contract and oracle edits.

implementer.reads: Frozen L0, contract, seal and RED receipt.
implementer.writes: Only the 38 canonical capsules in the 12 frozen productive consumers.
implementer.forbidden: Prompt, contract, baseline, oracle, attack, seal and test edits.

final_verifier.reads: All sealed artifacts and candidate outputs.
final_verifier.writes: P1346 final reports, receipts and limited certificate only.
final_verifier.forbidden: Any correction to inputs, tests or candidate.

causal_order: single final full plus runtime and architecture gates

budgets.stop: Any survivor, score below 1.0, repeated vector/cause, protected drift, missing external trust anchor, lint failure, ADR-0127 trigger or weakened negative blocks implementation and certificate.

scope_exclusions: Retention, discard, invalidation or terminal policy
Public API, default behavior, pipeline phase or compatibility change
limitations: The shared repository and inherited conversational context prevent strong isolation attestation.
Hashes identify inputs and order but do not prove filesystem isolation.

closed_world.rule: Manifest for P1346 only. Downstream artifacts must pin this file after its SHA-256 is computed; this manifest intentionally does not self-pin.
